title: Telemetry hooks: journey checkpoint events, error boundary reports, performance marks
description: The application emits named telemetry events at each declared journey checkpoint, reports every error-boundary catch with route and component context, and records performance marks at first paint and time-to-interactive. Event names follow the declared naming scheme so dashboards survive refactors.
rationale: A journey that cannot be observed cannot be improved. Naming the events in the spec stops telemetry being an unplanned afterthought with unstable names.
